notes.title: Patch Notes for Feb 14
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the maggot ai.
[*]Fixed a collision glitch that would let the player character fall through the floor.
[*]Made improvements to unintended visuals on the hospital backgrounds.
[*]Made changes to various levels, enemies, and platforms that were too difficult/hard to reach.
[/list]
